expected_demo_behaviour: Ember classifies each ticket (category, priority), drafts a reply for each, and proposes routing; the human approves before the deterministic routing flow files them and the UI board updates.
note: Fixed demo fixtures for the Help-desk Triage Desk (demo 2). Committed so rehearsals and final recorded runs are reproducible and cheap. Fictional tickets, modelled on Metagen's real help-desk shape: Jira intake, human approval before any AI reply goes out.
